name: Starter-Delta Fade
inputs: Official Week 10 injury report (game status Out/Doubtful) joined to the official club depth chart; replacement depth (2nd, 3rd, 4th string).
output: Signed availability delta in position groups, split offense and defense.
rule: Bet the side whose opponent is starting a 3rd-string or deeper replacement at a high-leverage position (QB, LT, CB1, EDGE1) and the other side is not.
lookahead: None. Injury and depth data are both published before kickoff.

name: Secondary Depletion Over
inputs: Official injury report joined to depth chart; count of Out/Doubtful players in the defensive backfield.
output: Count of unavailable defensive backs, and the depth of the worst replacement.
rule: Play the team total over (or game total over) when the opposing secondary is missing two or more of its top three corners or both starting safeties.

name: Net-Rating Divergence
inputs: Official standings: points for, points against, games played, home/road split.
output: Model spread derived from net points per game.
rule: Bet the side where the model spread and the market spread differ by more than a pre-registered threshold. BLOCKED until a market line exists (Q-02).

name: Rest-and-Travel Fade
inputs: Official schedule: game date, kickoff time, and bye-week status.
output: Days of rest and whether the opponent is coming off a bye.
rule: Fade a team playing on short rest against an opponent coming off its bye.

name: Same-Game Correlated Parlay: QB Stack
inputs: Requires per-player projections from play-by-play plus the correlation matrix.
output: Joint probability of a quarterback passing-yard leg and a receiver receiving-yard leg.
rule: Only construct the parlay when the estimated within-game residual correlation exceeds a pre-registered floor and the combined price beats the correlated fair price.
lookahead: None, but the estimator must be fitted on data strictly before the bet date.

name: Game-Script Parlay: Favourite Side + Under
inputs: Official standings ratings plus the correlation matrix.
output: Joint probability of a side and a total.
rule: Construct only when the side/total correlation is estimated as positive and material; otherwise treat the legs as independent and reject the price.

name: Two-Leg Uncorrelated Parlay
inputs: Any two strategies from different families with an estimated near-zero return correlation.
rule: Permitted only after the cross-strategy correlation is measured below a pre-registered ceiling.

name: Backup-QB Unders
inputs: Official injury report and depth chart; whether the starting quarterback is Out and who the next man is.
output: Indicator for a backup quarterback starting.
rule: Play the team total under when a backup quarterback starts, sized by the depth of the replacement (2nd string vs 3rd string).

name: Offensive-Line Continuity
inputs: Official injury report and depth chart across LT, LG, C, RG, RT.
output: Count of offensive line starters unavailable, and the depth of each replacement.
rule: Fade a team missing two or more offensive line starters, weighted toward the tackle positions.

name: Prop Combo: Receiver + Opponent Secondary
inputs: Requires per-player projections and the correlation matrix.
output: Joint probability of a receiver yardage over and the opposing team's secondary depletion indicator.
rule: Construct only when the correlation between the two legs is estimated and the price is beaten after correlation adjustment.
